history.russia-support.0006.all: Partial support. Both mention Lena shooting and strikes/agitation, so unrest. But A says pay better than most and gov insurance (1912) - contrasts B's hunger, long hours, low wages, Duma does nothing. Provenance: owner biased to blame agitators; leaflet propaganda. Judgement: supports unrest, challenges on wages/conditions.

history.russia-support.0060.all: Largely supports. Both: private traders/Nepmen back, seen as return of capitalism (A bourgeoisie back; B comrades complain); price issues (A high bread prices; B high manufactured prices). Difference: B stresses recovery (grain near pre-war, small industry flourishing); A says kulaks rich, wages low; B's price scissors hurts peasants not kulaks enriched. Provenance: angry idealist vs official report.

history.russia-support.0026.all: Partial. Both: freedoms granted, Constituent Assembly coming, war continued vs Germany. A adds weakness: dual power, Soviet orders obeyed first, govern with Soviet's permission; offensive forced by allies - contradicts B's confident picture. Provenance: private diary candid vs public speech propaganda.

history.russia-support.0058.all: Some support. Both: NEP allowed private trade/capitalist elements (A step back, peasants incentive; B bourgeoisie back) and some comrades see betrayal (A notes many call it betrayal; B asks is this communism). Differ: A says not capitalism, breathing space, state keeps large industry; B sees kulaks rich, workers poor. Provenance: Lenin justifying policy vs disillusioned member.
